\begin{figure}
\caption{Simulation results. The reversal time clearly decreases with increasing tilt angle, demonstrating that crystal orientation enables field-free switching. The threshold current agrees well with the model.}
\label{fig:before}

\begin{figure}
\caption{Spin-orbit-torque switching of a single-domain Mn3Sn film for several tilt angles of the kagome plane. (a) Octupole component $m_z$ as a function of time $t$ after the current is applied, for tilt angles $\theta = 0$, 15, 30 and 45 degrees (solid, dashed, dotted and dash-dotted lines). (b) Threshold current density $j_c$ as a function of $\theta$. Circles: atomistic spin-dynamics simulation; solid line: analytical model, Eq.~\eqref{eq:model}. The damping constant is $\alpha = 0.003$ in both panels.}
\label{fig:after}
\end{figure}
